# Lenis 1.3.27

Locally hosted, unmodified browser distribution from [Lenis](https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis), pinned to version 1.3.27. The site does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

Source files: `https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.min.js` and `https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.css`.

The MIT license is preserved in `lenis-LICENSE`.
